programming.name: Theme Craft
programming.summary: Study a darker set of sounds, a goth dress code, an underground room, and a few things for people to do.

programming.name: Specific Nights
programming.summary: Study the stranger genres, dress codes, atmospheres, and things for people to do.

programming.name: Fuller Nights
programming.summary: A night can hold 10 choices, and you can book a draw plus the stranger things people do.

bar.name: Better Drinks
bar.summary: Each guest spends a little more. The night pays for the next one.

bar.name: Remember Orders
bar.summary: Someone remembers what they drink. Regulars start to trust the place.

security.name: Calm Door
security.summary: The door feels safe. A few more people stay instead of turning around.

security.name: Look After the Room
security.summary: Small nights feel looked after, so the people who need that actually show up.

community.name: Learn Names
community.summary: Regulars come back more often once the place knows who they are.

community.name: Ask Them to Bring Someone
community.summary: Nights that invite a friend start to work.

venue.name: Room Flow
venue.summary: People can find a place to stand. Slightly more of them stay.

venue.name: Protect the Small Room
venue.summary: The chill room stays a chill room, and the people who need it can tell.
